text:
• Find projects more easily with the new project switcher, including projects from other GitHub users.
• Focus your task list with a custom issue filter for each project.
• Manage conversations more effectively: hide or delete comments directly from an issue.
• View a detailed changelog from Settings.

iOS

• The Home Screen widget now shows when it was last updated and has improved project and issue handling.
• Improved widget reliability after device unlock and when working with closed issues.
